payload.detail: TRACKING HALF ONLY, shipped 2026-09-18 (PR #2884, merged). The canary's existing failure issue is titled 'evaluation did not complete' and fires on failure(), so a run that COMPLETES but fails the blocking answer-quality threshold was not covered — which is precisely why three cases have failed since 23 August with nothing tracking it. That step now covers the completed-but-failing outcome too. THE THREE FAILING CASES THEMSELVES ARE UNTOUCHED AND STAY DEFERRED: fixing them is answer-generation work on a protected surface, needing a before-and-after provider comparison run (~USD 1-2) with explicit owner approval, and it cannot be verified offline. This row now means 'the three cases are still failing', not 'nobody knows they are failing'.
